questions.question: The grill flags that /health is fresh code, and decision 0012 says its deviation 'does not extend to any code written fresh' — so strictly /health owes a global exception handler and structured JSON logging with correlationId. But those are app-wide infrastructure (you can't have a global handler for just one endpoint), and they don't exist yet. How should api-surface-trim handle this?
options: Build the global handler + structured logging now
questions.chosen: Build the global handler + structured logging now
